I know I sound like a broken record because I just mentioned some of this, but yeah, it really is ruining everything. I can't even enjoy my hobbies anymore. 

Like, I used to love tinkering and building things. A few months ago, I bought this resin 3D printer. But then I started reading about the photopolymer resin and how toxic it is before it cures. If you get it on your skin, you can develop a severe contact dermatitis allergy that never goes away. And the fumes... I realized I couldn't just use it in the house. I had to build a custom enclosure with negative pressure, venting out the window.

So I started designing this automated blackout blind system using a Raspberry Pi and some stepper motors. I went down this massive rabbit hole trying to program the motor controller, which is ironic because I write code for a living, but my brain is just so fried lately. 

So now the printer and all the parts for the enclosure are just sitting there. It's just another one of those projects at home I'm leaving half-finished. I never even printed a single thing. And it makes being around my wife really hard, because she sees all this clutter, and when we try to just sit and watch a movie or hang out, I show up so distracted by the resin toxicity or the motor code that she feels completely ignored. So the arguments just keep escalating. 

And I can't even use work as an escape or get any satisfaction there, because, like I said, my manager has started documenting those missed architectural details. I just...
